chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan from Zura ibn Muhammad from Sama'a from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That a eunuch disguised himself (as a man) to a woman, he said: 'They are separated, and the woman takes her dowry from him, and his back is beaten as he disguised himself.'

key_terms.دَلَّسَ نَفْسَهُ: Disguised himself / Concealed his true nature

ai.seo_question: What is the legal consequence when a eunus maries a woman by disguising himself as a man?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific judicial remedy for *tadlis* (disguise) in marriage, where a eunuch deceives a woman by presenting himself as a man. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes the dissolution of the marriage contract, the retention of the full dowry by the wife, and corporal punishment for the deceiver, establishing a precedent for compensating the aggrieved party based on the nature of the concealment.
